subject: dxf/importinto: run table-empty check once per task (#65970)
summary: Reviewed ed7133b vs first parent focusing on DDL/dxf metadata behavior. The table-empty recheck is moved from per-subtask executor Init to a per-task scheduler gate at StepInit (classic kernel), preventing false failures on task-executor recreation while still enforcing the post-precheck emptiness condition. DDL helper now builds a table from TableInfo (TableFromMeta) for the KV-level emptiness scan; and import job metadata is fixed so FailJob transitions pending->failed (avoids leaving jobs stuck pending when tasks revert at init). Scanned later history up to upstream/master for touched files; no follow-up fixes related to this change were found.
